name: After § 25
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 25a. Underlines that the salaries and benefits received by Commissioners, MEPs and the President of the European Council are very generous; is concerned that these disproportionately high salaries completely alienate them from people’s everyday lives, needs and struggles; considers, therefore, that allocating them more reasonable salaries and benefits would increase the chance of the 2026 budget proposals being more in line with working people’s needs;
